limitations: Bootstrap quantifies roster sampling uncertainty conditional on observed decodes; no independent decoding variance estimate.
Numeric gate alone does not establish stable cross-task improvement.

label_diagnostics.scope: Descriptive full-answer metrics conditional on original gold labels; slot slices overlap, are not slot-specific F1, and must not be summed. Only observed intent-slot relations are included. No per-label significance or candidate promotion is claimed.

analysis_correction.scope: TRAIN utterance identity normalization and scorer selected from frozen registered raw official TRAIN config; inference unchanged
